summary: Tests with `testIsolation` start faster after tests that load no pages. Fixes `cy.contains()` inside `cy.document().within()` and decoding of `x-gzip` responses, plus a 16.0.0 cross-origin hang.
Adds a built-in `cy.getByRole()` query by ARIA role and accessible name. Fixes regressions in mTLS client certificates, cookies after `cy.request()`, and `cy.go()` page-load waits.
